tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mgon po mched brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi thig rtsa bzhugs so//

/ma hā kā lā mched brgyad kyi// rjes gnang dkyil 'khor 'di lta ste// thig chen brgyad gdab bcu drug dbye// dbus kyi lte ba gru gsum la// mu khyud ldan pa'i phyi rtsibs brgyad// de'i phyir rtsig pa 'dod snam dang*// pha gu dra phyed ba kuu li// shar bu mda' yab dag dang bcas// rta babs snam bu bcu gcig la// gu ṇa ha ris brgyan pa ste// ra dang bcas pa spyi ltar bris// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa// sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes par bya// phyi rol pad rdor dur khrod dang*// 'od zer 'bar ba'i me ri bri// tshon yig chog gzhung dkyus su gsal// lha mtshan dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag /zur gsum tshom bu nag po gsum/ /mu khyud tshom bu nag po dgu| |rtsibs brgyad yi ge hūm̐ sngon brgyad// khyams la tshom bu ci mang dgod// phyi yi khyams chen tshom bu ni// sna tshogs mdog can ci mang ste// de ltar shes ldan dag gis bri// bsdu na 'bru nag tshom bu'ang rung*// zhes pa 'di yang man ngag ltar// dharma kīrtis zla dgon du// bkod pas mgon brgyad dgyes gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ//
